`toCsv` in `src/exports/csvExport.ts` now writes a `created_at` column as the last column, after `rating`. Each value is the row's `createdAt` as an ISO 8601 string, for example `2026-10-16T12:00:00.000Z`. I haven't run the code or any tests.

`createdAt` is typed as a `Date` on `ExportRow`, so `toISOString()` throws on an invalid date. It would also throw if a row came back from `loadBatch` with `createdAt` as a string, for example from JSON. I didn't check what `loadBatch` returns at runtime.
